subject: Modwerk needs maintainers
body:
Hey guys,

I have to be honest with you: Modwerk hangs by a thin thread. More than 700 pull requests were merged in the last month, and nearly every one of them was reviewed and merged by me. 18 are waiting as I write this. If I'm away for a week, the work stops for everyone who sends a module, and for everyone waiting to play it.

So I'm urgently looking for maintainers who review and merge code.

- **Review pull requests**
  Modules, base work, site and SDK fixes: check them against the modding guidelines, the checks and the hardware evidence, and tell authors clearly what's missing.
- **Merge what's ready**
  So a good module doesn't wait days for one person.
- **Look after one area**
  One machine, the Octatrack base, the site or the Worker. You don't need to know all of it.

You're a good fit if you've built or reviewed a module, know one of the instruments well, or read TypeScript, C or DSP and ColdFire assembly. A few hours a week already makes a real difference.

For the past month the Octatrack beta has been loading modules over USB: no card, no restart, undone with a power cycle. Other projects are now taking up the same approach. It's good to see the idea work, but I'd much rather we build it together than build it several times over. If you're working on mods or USB loading for Elektron instruments, come and talk to me. The code is public on GitHub, and work done here is credited to whoever did it.

Interested? Message me in the development Discord and tell me what you'd like to look after.

[Join the development Discord](https://discord.gg/vzfAdMBtn5)

Thank you,\
Jannik
